entry.name: jiraSite
entry.label: Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

entry.name: jiraEmail
entry.label: Jira account email

entry.name: jiraToken
entry.label: Jira API token (NOT password)

entry.name: jira2Enabled
entry.label: Enable a second Jira instance with its own credentials.

entry.name: jira2Site
entry.label: Second Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://other.atlassian.net

entry.name: jira2Email
entry.label: Second Jira account email

entry.name: jira2Token
entry.label: Second Jira API token (NOT password)

entry.name: jira1BlockColor
entry.label: Block color (hex) for the first Jira instance. Drawn translucent.

entry.name: jira2BlockColor
entry.label: Block color (hex) for the second Jira instance. Drawn translucent.

entry.name: jira1ClockifyProjectId
entry.label: Clockify project id that the first Jira's worklogs sync into.

entry.name: jira2ClockifyProjectId
entry.label: Clockify project id that the second Jira's worklogs sync into.

entry.name: worklogPopupWidth
entry.label: Popup width in pixels

entry.name: worklogPopupHeight
entry.label: Popup height in pixels

entry.name: worklogModalWidth
entry.label: Default width of the new/edit worklog modal, in pixels.

entry.name: worklogModalHeight
entry.label: Default height of the new/edit worklog modal, in pixels.

entry.name: worklogShowSprintGauges
entry.label: Show the bottom panel (Sprint/Horas rings or the monthly heatmap) below the calendar, in every mode. The view is chosen by the vertical switch / worklogBottomView.

entry.name: worklogBottomView
entry.label: Which bottom-panel view to show: "rings" (Sprint + Horas gauges), "subtasks" (subtask table) or "heatmap" (monthly hours table). Toggled by the vertical switch / mouse wheel on the right of the panel.

entry.name: worklogShowSubtaskTable
entry.label: Show the third bottom-panel section: a table of subtasks filtered by worklogSubtaskJql.

entry.name: worklogSubtaskJql
entry.label: JQL that drives the subtask table. Default: my open subtasks.
entry.default: issuetype in subTaskIssueTypes() AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

entry.name: worklogSubtaskShowParent
entry.label: Show the parent-issue column (with tooltip showing the parent's summary) in the subtask table.

entry.name: worklogSprintStrategy
entry.label: How to discover the active sprint. One of: "subtask-customfield" (default) — scan subtasks assigned to the user and pick the entry with state="active" in their sprint custom field. Works when only subtasks are assigned to the user. "agile-board" — query /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/sprint?state=active with worklogSprintBoardId. Requires the board id. "assignee-jql" — original 0.4.0 behavior using "sprint in openSprints() AND assignee = currentUser()". Use as a fallback.

entry.name: worklogSprintField
entry.label: Name of the Jira issue field that holds the sprint array. Defaults to customfield_10020 which is the standard on most Jira Cloud instances; older / customised instances may use a different customfield_NNNNN id, or simply "sprint" if the field is exposed top-level.

entry.name: worklogSprintBoardId
entry.label: Board id used by the agile-board strategy. Visible at /jira/software/c/projects/.../boards/<id> in the URL.

entry.name: worklogRemainingMode
entry.label: How to compute the remaining hours used by the "Horas" ring (Disponible) and by the right column of the issue picker. "api" uses Jira's remainingEstimateSeconds (the value shown in the issue's Remaining field). "calculated" uses originalEstimateSeconds - timeSpentSeconds (clamped at 0), useful when remainingEstimate isn't kept in sync as you log time.

entry.name: worklogDailyTargetHours
entry.label: Daily target hours (used for the per-day diff in the totals row)

entry.name: worklogIssueJql
entry.label: JQL used to populate the issue picker in the new-worklog modal
entry.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

entry.name: worklogIssueMax
entry.label: Max issues to show in the picker

entry.name: worklogShowIssueSummary
entry.label: Append the issue summary (title) after the key on each worklog block. The key is always shown.

entry.name: worklogSource
entry.label: Which calendar data source to render: "jira", "clockify" or "jira-clockify" (split).

entry.name: worklogPinned
entry.label: If true the popup stays open after focus loss (toggled by the pin button).

entry.name: worklogDebug
entry.label: Log every Jira request to plasmashell stdout

entry.name: clockifyApiKey
entry.label: Clockify API key (Profile → Settings → API)

entry.name: clockifyWorkspaceId
entry.label: Resolved workspace id (auto-filled after the first sync). Leave empty to use the user's default workspace.

entry.name: clockifyUserId
entry.label: Resolved Clockify user id (auto-filled).

entry.name: clockifyDefaultProjectId
entry.label: Optional project id to preselect in the new-entry modal and used by the Jira→Clockify sync.

entry.name: clockifyBillableDefault
entry.label: Default value of the "billable" toggle when creating a new Clockify entry.

entry.name: clockifyDebug
entry.label: Log every Clockify request to plasmashell stdout.

entry.name: googleCalEnabled
entry.label: Show Google Calendar events as immovable background blocks on the calendar. Toggled by the check button on the top-right of the popup header.

entry.name: googleClientId
entry.label: Google OAuth client id (type "TV and Limited Input devices").

entry.name: googleClientSecret
entry.label: Google OAuth client secret paired with googleClientId.

entry.name: googleRefreshToken
entry.label: OAuth refresh token obtained from the one-time device-code authorization. Exchanged for access tokens at runtime.

entry.name: googleCalendarId
entry.label: Legacy single calendar id (kept for migration). Use googleCalendarIds for the up-to-3 multi-calendar list.

entry.name: googleCalendarIds
entry.label: Up to 3 calendar ids to read events from, parallel to googleCalendarColors. When empty, falls back to googleCalendarId.

entry.name: googleCalendarColors
entry.label: Base block color (hex, e.g. #e74c3c) for each calendar in googleCalendarIds. Always rendered translucent. Missing entries default to a translucent red.

entry.name: googleCalDebug
entry.label: Log every Google Calendar request to plasmashell stdout.
